verdict.reason: My raw covered-set quality mean is 7.63125 (244.2/32), below 8.0 on its own; no cohort reaches 8.0 except settings (8.0). The remaining defects are small and specific (compose toolbar font/phone editor geometry, reader More actions sizing/phone wrap, contacts phone row wrap and header alignment, mixed disclosure styles), not broken flows. I do not demand another round; the parent's combined Claude/Sol rounded measure decides progression.
